deep.reconstruction:
Setting, inferred from the surrounding pages. X is a topological space with a family of open subsets (X_i), i in I, indexed by an ordered set I (conditions a), b) of (1')). The previous page indicates the X_i grow with i (X_k ⊂ X_i for k ≤ i).

For each r, the 'flag space' is X_{Δ_r} ⊂ X × I_{Δ_r}. Its points are pairs (x, i_0 ≤ … ≤ i_r) with x in X_{i_0}. So X_{Δ_r} is the disjoint union of the X_{i_0} over all flags of length r. Monotone maps α: Δ_{r'} → Δ_r give operations α*. When α(0)=0 these are étale coverings; in general they are local homeomorphisms over X.

In particular:
- X_{Δ_0} = ∐_i X_i.
- X_{Δ_1} ⊂ X_{Δ_0} × X_{Δ_0} consists of the pairs ((x,i),(x,j)) with i ≤ j. It is a closed-and-open subset of the fibre product X_{Δ_0} ×_X X_{Δ_0}.

NB on this page (removing redundancies). One can keep only the non-degenerate flags, i.e. strictly increasing sequences. The system then becomes semi-simplicial: only strictly increasing α act, which is what '½ simplicial' means. X_{Δ_0} is unchanged. X_{Δ_1} is replaced by X_{Δ_1} minus the diagonal of X_{Δ_0} × X_{Δ_0}, i.e. the pairs with i < j.

Main goal: reconstruct X from the semi-simplicial space X_{Δ_*}. Grothendieck writes down the square X_{Δ_1} ⇉ X_{Δ_0} → X, with the two face maps a and b. He wants X to be the amalgamated sum X_{Δ_0} ⊔_{X_{Δ_1}} X_{Δ_0}.

The next page gives sufficient conditions:
- c) X = ∪ X_i;
- d) X_i ∩ X_j = ∪_{k ≤ i, k ≤ j} X_k.

Under these, the map lim→ X_{Δ_*} → X is a homeomorphism. Why this works:
- X_{Δ_0} → X is a surjective (by c)) local homeomorphism, hence an open quotient map.
- The equivalence relation it induces is X_{Δ_0} ×_X X_{Δ_0}.
- Condition d) says this relation is generated by the order relation X_{Δ_1}. If x lies in X_i ∩ X_j, choose k ≤ i, j with x in X_k; then (x,i) ~ (x,k) ~ (x,j).

So X is the quotient of the 'topological preorder' (X_{Δ_0}, X_{Δ_1}). That is, X is the orbit space of an étale topological category. In the stratified-topos project this is the start of describing a space, or topos, through an ordered étale presentation indexed by the poset of strata. The aborted Corollary on the next page heads toward exactly this: start from an abstract 'ordered topological space' (X_0, X_1 ⊂ X_0 × X_0) and build X.
errors: The 'cocartesian square' / amalgamated sum X_{Δ_0} ⊔_{X_{Δ_1}} X_{Δ_0} in (19)/(20) is, read literally as a pushout of two copies, only correct in the degenerate-flag variant. There the diagonal pairs (i ≤ i) identify the two copies. In the non-degenerate variant just introduced (pairs with i < j only) the pushout fails. Example: if I has one element, X_{Δ_1} is empty and the pushout is X ⊔ X, not X. The correct statement is a coequalizer (colimit of X_{Δ_1} ⇉ X_{Δ_0}), as the next page (22) indeed formulates with lim→ X_{Δ_*}. The next page's claim that the result holds for both variants is right for the coequalizer/colimit formulation, not for the literal pushout (20).
Minor: the conditions (c), (d) needed for (20) are not yet stated on this page; they are supplied on the next one.

ideas.what: Flag spaces X_{Δ_r} = ∐_{flags i_0 ≤ … ≤ i_r} X_{i_0}, forming a (semi-)simplicial space of local homeomorphisms over X, attached to a poset-indexed open cover
ideas.modern_name: Nerve / Čech-type semi-simplicial resolution of a poset-indexed open cover (Grothendieck construction of the functor I → Open(X))
ideas.usually_credited_to: Segal (Classifying spaces and spectral sequences, 1968), tom Dieck; later Dugger–Isaksen on hypercovers

ideas.what: Discarding degenerate flags to get a semi-simplicial (strictly increasing) version
ideas.modern_name: Semi-simplicial (Δ_inj) objects / fat versus thin nerve

ideas.what: Recovering X as the colimit (coequalizer) of X_{Δ_1} ⇉ X_{Δ_0} under the covering and 'intersection generated by smaller members' conditions
ideas.modern_name: Descent along an étale surjection; X as the orbit space of an étale topological category/preorder; colimit over a basis-like cover
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore (sheaf/descent theory); étale categories: Haefliger, Moerdijk

missed.claim: Grothendieck heads toward presenting a space, in the stratified-topos context, as the quotient of an abstract 'ordered topological space' (X_0, X_1 ⊂ X_0 × X_0) with étale structure maps. This is an étale topological preorder/category as presentation data, rather than an étale groupoid. It parallels later uses of étale categories (Moerdijk) and poset-indexed covers in exit-path / stratified homotopy theory, though this page itself is elementary.
missed.quote: Reconstitution de X à partir du syst. ½ simplicial X_{Δ_*}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only as historical context for Grothendieck's 1981 stratified-topos programme. The mathematics on this page is standard.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine construction (nerve of an ordered open cover and recovery of X by coequalizer). The only notable point is a small slip: the pushout formulation fails in the non-degenerate variant.
transcription_corrections: 'qu'on récupère X comme un espace[?] analogue[?]' should read 'qu'on récupère X comme somme amalgamée'.
The superscript '13' after 'aurait' is a reference mark to the operations (13) of the earlier page, not part of the sentence.
'ops.[?]' is the abbreviation 'opérations' (… se restreindre aux opérations ½ simpliciales relatives …).
